item.title: Vitamin B12 Dosage Explained: How Much You Really Need Per Day
item.description: Vitamin B12 is essential for nerve function and red blood cell production, with daily needs varying by age, pregnancy status, and health. While most people get enough from animal-based foods, older adults, vegetarians, and those with absorption issues may need supplements. Deficiency can cause fatigue, nerve symptoms, and anemia, while excess intake is generally safe under medical guidance.

item.title: Tilak Varma's Return Confirmed, Will Play This Match Before T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: The return of Tilak Varma is a significant boost for India's T20 World Cup title defence. After recovering from a testicular surgery sustained during a Ranji Trophy match, the 23-year-old is set to rejoin the national team in Mumbai. He successfully completed a high-intensity simulation match post-rehabilitation at the BCCI Centre of Excellence.

item.title: High-Mileage Bikes For Long Daily Rides On A Budget
item.description: High-mileage bikes for long daily rides on a budget include models such as the Hero Splendor Plus Xtec, TVS Sport, Bajaj Platina, Honda Shine 125 and Hero Splendor Plus.
